div.div: The parser stops for the whole round trip and the execution. Every millisecond of that is nothing on screen.

div.div: Downloads in parallel, but runs the instant it lands — mid-document, and in whatever order the network returns.

div.div: Parallel download, uninterrupted parse, execution in order with the whole DOM available. The default for your own code.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 756px; height: 1px; padding-top: 461px; margin-left: 40px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-warn-fg);

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-warn-fg); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: defer for your own code — parallel download, in-document-order execution, DOM guaranteed. async only for a third party that touches nothing of yours. A plain <script> in the head is a blank screen for the length of a round trip.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 770px; height: 1px; padding-top: 511px; margin-left: 25px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: var(--dg-muted);

display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-muted); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-style: italic; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Inline scripts always block, attribute or not. type="module" is deferred by default — even inline — and fetched with CORS.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
